say:1:1421433001:1.text: I take it you're one of Thador's subordinates. Did he leave any messages for me?
say:1:1421433001:1.source_cn: 我想，你就是都铎留下的部下吧？他有没有什么话或者东西让...

say:2:1421433002:1.text: I don't know what you're talking about, Your Highness.
say:2:1421433002:1.source_cn: 我听不懂您在说什么，沙利叶大人。

say:3:1421433003:1.text: I only came to seek an audience with you to discuss... the matter of the Divine Dew supply.
say:3:1421433003:1.source_cn: 我只是想要求见您，询问……询问灵露供应的问题。

say:4:1421433004:1.text: Oh please. If you're going to lie to royalty, at least put some effort into it, dear. That was downright embarrassing.
say:4:1421433004:1.source_cn: 大部分人被我挡在面前的时候都不会是这种回答方式，亲爱的...

say:5:1421433005:1.text: Fine. If you insist on wasting time... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do the honors.
say:5:1421433005:1.source_cn: 算了，看起来还是得走个无聊的流程。拜托你了，<styl...
say:5:1421433005:1.male: Fine. If you insist on wasting time... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do the honors.
say:5:1421433005:1.female: Fine. If you insist on wasting time... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do the honors.

say:6:1421433006:1.text: Let's hope your eloquence makes this little delay somewhat entertaining.
say:6:1421433006:1.source_cn: 希望你的口才能让这不得不耗费掉的时间变得更有趣些。
say:6:1421433006:1.male: Let's hope your eloquence makes this little delay somewhat entertaining.
say:6:1421433006:1.female: Let's hope your eloquence makes this little delay somewhat entertaining.

say:7:1421433007:1.text: Here's a hint—Thador's men are all cut from the same dull, duty-obsessed cloth.
say:7:1421433007:1.source_cn: 给你个提示，都铎的部下跟他一样，都是热爱工作的死脑筋。
say:7:1421433007:1.male: Here's a hint—Thador's men are all cut from the same dull, duty-obsessed cloth.
say:7:1421433007:1.female: Here's a hint—Thador's men are all cut from the same dull, duty-obsessed cloth.

say:8:1421433008:1.text: A little pressure, the right approach... prying open their mouths is hundreds of times easier than prying open their armor.
say:8:1421433008:1.source_cn: 用对了方法，撬开他们的嘴比撬开他们的铠甲可轻松几百倍呢。
say:8:1421433008:1.male: A little pressure, the right approach... prying open their mouths is hundreds of times easier than prying open their armor.
say:8:1421433008:1.female: A little pressure, the right approach... prying open their mouths is hundreds of times easier than prying open their armor.
